title: A2.1 — Imperfect, Reflexives, & Basic Subjunctive
description: Describe past habits and ongoing situations, talk about daily routines, make comparisons, and express wishes and commands using basic subjunctive.

themes.title: Affirmative and Negative Sentences
themes.description: Learn to form negative sentences and double negatives in Spanish, plus affirmative equivalents.

themes.title: Arts & Literature
themes.description: Discuss art forms, literature, music, cinema, and creative expression. Learn vocabulary for museums, galleries, books, instruments, and artistic activities. Practice the present tense for describing art and cultural routines, 'gustar' for expressing preferences, the preterite for cultural experiences, and demonstratives for describing visual art.

themes.title: Basic Subjunctive
themes.description: Use the present subjunctive in fixed expressions: wishes, hopes, and Ojalá.

themes.title: Comparatives and Superlatives
themes.description: Compare people, things, and ideas using más/menos/tan and el/la más/el/la menos.

themes.title: Culture & Traditions
themes.description: Talk about festivals, customs, traditions, and cultural practices. Describe celebrations, traditional food, and cultural differences using gustar, ser vs. estar, and possessive adjectives.

themes.title: Economy & Business
themes.description: Discuss money, banking, commerce, and basic economics. Learn vocabulary for financial transactions, business entities, and economic concepts. Practice the present tense for routines, the past tense for purchases, formal commands for business interactions, and conditional for hypothetical financial situations.

themes.title: Environment & Nature
themes.description: Talk about nature, weather, seasons, environmental issues, and conservation using the imperfect for past descriptions, reflexive verbs for nature activities, and basic subjunctive for expressing environmental concerns.

themes.title: Hace... Que Expressions
themes.description: Master the hace + time + que construction for talking about duration and time in the past.

themes.title: Imperfect — The Three Irregulars
themes.description: Learn the three imperfect irregulars: IR (iba), VER (veía), and SER (era).

themes.title: Reflexives in the Imperfect
themes.description: Describe past daily routines using reflexive verbs in the imperfect tense.

themes.title: Imperfect — Regular Verbs
themes.description: Master regular imperfect conjugations for -AR, -ER, and -IR verbs to describe ongoing and habitual past actions.

themes.title: Imperfect vs. Preterite
themes.description: Understand when to use the imperfect versus the preterite — the key decision point for Spanish past tenses.

themes.title: Indefinite Expressions
themes.description: Learn algo, alguien, alguno, nada, nadie, nunca, siempre and other indefinite expressions in Spanish.

themes.title: Law & Rights
themes.description: Discuss legal rights, duties, and bureaucracy. Learn vocabulary for legal terms, rights, duties, and everyday interactions with institutions. Practice the present subjunctive for rights and obligations, formal commands, and passive constructions.

themes.title: Media & News
themes.description: Discuss TV, radio, newspapers, social media, and current events using relative pronouns, passive se, past subjunctive for hypothetical scenarios, and object pronouns for media consumption.

themes.title: Object Pronouns
themes.description: Learn direct and indirect object pronouns (me, te, lo, la, le, nos, los, las, les).

themes.title: Past Experiences & Stories
themes.description: Tell stories and describe past experiences using the preterite and imperfect tenses, with narrative connectors and time markers.

themes.title: Plans & Future Intentions
themes.description: Talk about future plans, intentions, and predictions using the 'ir a + infinitivo' construction, the simple future tense, and expressions of intention.

themes.title: Por vs. Para
themes.description: Master the difference between 'por' and 'para' — two of the most challenging Spanish prepositions for learners.

themes.title: Preterite vs Imperfect
themes.description: Master the difference between preterite (past completed) and imperfect (past ongoing/habitual) tenses in Spanish.

themes.title: Preterite Tense Regular and Irregular
themes.description: Learn to conjugate regular and irregular verbs in the preterite tense for completed past actions.

themes.title: Reflexive Verbs
themes.description: Master reflexive verbs (levantarse, ducharse, sentirse) and pronoun usage in Spanish.

themes.title: Relationships & Social Life
themes.description: Talk about friendships, dating, family dynamics, social events, and interpersonal relationships in Spanish. Learn vocabulary for describing relationships, social interactions, and personal connections.

themes.title: Science & Technology
themes.description: Talk about science, inventions, and technology in daily life. Learn vocabulary for scientific concepts, inventions, and everyday technology. Practice the present perfect for recent discoveries and experiences, comparatives and superlatives for technology comparisons, and the future tense for predictions.

themes.title: Ser vs. Estar
themes.description: Master the crucial difference between ser and estar — two forms of 'to be' in Spanish.
